the annual Spring Festival passenger traffic flow is the result of the interaction of social,economic,and cultural factors,and the solution to this problem should be based on the comprehensive analysis of these factors.

the migrant worker flow in passenger transportation during the Spring Festival is the result of the current social structure changes in China and an inevitable manifestation of the influence that traditional culture has on behavior choice.

it is necessary to make full use of the advantages of the traditional culture and the social economic system in China,as well as to make full use the advantages of the social economic system and the traditional culture of the destination areas to guide the migrant worker flow in passenger traffic in Spring Festival.
